name: Red-Thread Spool
description: A warm spool that catches only on relationships someone has chosen to carry forward.

name: Blank Provenance Card
description: A waterproof card with separate spaces for source, event, rendering, permission, and uncertainty.

name: Unfinished Prism
description: A many-sided glass beginning whose final facet must be chosen by the person whose light passes through it.

name: Context Seed
description: A labeled grain containing one useful memory and no claim to contain the whole past.

name: Concordance Compass
description: Its needles point separately toward source custody, event evidence, and the nearest declared interpretation.

name: Five-Finger Meraki Brush
description: A soft brush split into five imperfect tips, made for leaving attention visible in the final image.

name: Goldfish Loop Token
description: A brass ring stamped DREAM, ACHIEVE, and REPEAT, with the last word pointing back to the first.

name: Fermata Clapper
description: The missing heart of the February Third bell. It remains silent whenever its holder asks for time.

name: Halfway Cup
description: A bubble-tea cup with two handles set at different heights; it is easiest to carry with someone else.

name: Return-Path Checklist
description: A launch card asking what could go wrong, who consented, where the source lives, and how to turn back.
